svg.title: The Gibbs distribution of every logit vector the specimen produced, as the temperature falls.
svg.desc: 3040 logit columns z ∈ ℝ⁷ (80 per moment, 40 moments of training: AdamW, η 0.02 → 0.002 (warmup 20, cosine), β₂ 0.95, weight decay 0.01 on matrices, clip 1). Each path is p_β = softmax(βz) for β from 0.01 to 25, projected linearly onto the plane with the seven characters ␣ b e n o r t at the corners of the heptagon (value ink, clockwise from the top). Every path starts at the uniform centre; it ends at a corner when one character wins, and on an edge or face when the text is genuinely ambiguous.
